Game Overview

At its heart, FlapCat Christmas is a cats game about guide FlapCat and his reindeer through the winter sky in this festive challenge. Perfect timing and precision clicking are key as you navigate holiday-themed obstacles. Embrace the Christmas spirit with new designs while aiming to deliver gifts. Prepare for hours of addictive and merry fun!
